title: TD Social iPhone app: first builds, slim phone screens, Privacy and Support pages
text: TD Social, the iPhone app for the team, now exists: the first builds went to TestFlight. It shows CRM pages such as Inbox, WhatsApp, Portal Chats, TD Talk and the Marketing chat in slimmer phone layouts, lets you pinch-zoom, and opens email attachments in the phone's own viewer with Done and Share. Public Privacy Policy and Support pages were added for the App Store.
points: The Inbox and WhatsApp lists use two slim bars instead of four (about 13% of the screen instead of about 28%).
On the computer nothing changes: the phone layouts apply only inside the app.
The new icon (blue TD logo with 'social' in red) appears only with the next build that goes through Apple's review.
Alerts to phones are built but not turned on yet.
